## Where to find it

Not found as loot.

- Found wherever a [Wheel](Wheel) is listed as loot: 0.3 % of those finds are this wheel.
- Taken off a vehicle it fits with a [Tyre Wrench](Tyre-Wrench).
- The only wheel these 2 vehicle types take: Combine, Tractor.

## Crafting

No recipe makes or uses it.

## Scrap

Cannot be scrapped: a Scrap Machine destroys it, see [Scrap](Scrap).
